thread:
jamie: Quick follow-up from the canary — we observed weird hedging where the router picked higher-cost regional variants when the probe signal was missing. Proposal: runtime should publish a lightweight `probe_cost_estimate` (95p latency + expected GPU cents) so policies can make deterministic choices. Thoughts?

mohit: Agree this explains the oscillation. Are you proposing the runtime compute this or the policy layer to estimate on-demand? cc @sara

sara: Runtime, ideally. It can emit a tiny histogram + mean cost per model-variant. That keeps policy simple and consistent.

aline: Risk: exposing raw cost might leak pricing surfaces to tenants. Could we expose a normalized `cost_score` (0-1) instead of raw cents?

jamie: Good call. Suggestion: emit both `cost_score` and optional raw `probe_cost` gated by an enterprise/privacy flag. Default: only cost_score.

dev-bot: deploy/canary finished: route-metrics probe_missing=0.7% :white_check_mark:

mohit: If we add `cost_score`, our policy DSL needs to accept continuous values. Current DSL mostly uses enums/buckets, so this is an ABI change for older adapters.

sara: We can add a compiler helper that bucketizes `cost_score` into policy-friendly enums for legacy adapters. That keeps runtime output numeric while preserving compatibility.

aline: Operational constraints: probe values should have short TTL (30s?) to avoid stale hedging decisions, and always include `source_region` tag so policies can see origin. Also include a `probe_fresh` boolean for quick checks.

jamie: Draft checklist I'm putting into a tiny RFC PR: 1) runtime emits `cost_score` (0-1), optional `probe_cost` (raw cents) behind privacy gate, `source_region`, `ttl_seconds`, and `probe_fresh` flag; 2) policy DSL accepts numeric `cost_score` and provides `bucketize_cost(score, buckets)` helper; 3) policy compiler adds compatibility transform for adapters that expect enums; 4) docs + console columns for visibility.

mohit: I'll take the runtime change. Plan: feature branch -> extend `route_decision` proto with optional fields, opt-in via `probe_signals: true` flag, add unit tests for TTL logic.

sara: I'll update the policy compiler & add `bucketize_cost` util. Can we sync tomorrow for a quick handoff? 10am PT works for me.

jamie: :thumbsup: Added a 15m follow-up tomorrow 10am PT. I'll open the PR with the checklist and a small example policy snippet (`if cost_score < 0.2 then prefer(region=edge)`).

aline: One more: include a note in the RFC about how this interacts with fallback windows — cost_score should be compared against smoothed values, not instantaneous ones.

jamie: Good point — will add a recommendation for exponential smoothing with a 5-15s half-life. Filing RFC PR now.
